reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: handle_debt_auto_deleverage has an active non-test caller at contracts/protocol/sources/entry_points/lending/liquidate.move:229. Gate 2: No trust_assumptions table in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; gate inapplicable. Gate 3: contracts/protocol/sources/internal/market/market.move is explicitly in-scope and liquidation logic is a listed focus area. Code confirms the violation: handle_debt_auto_deleverage routes through liquidation_inner (L597-610 in market.move), which unconditionally calls obligation.withdraw_ctokens(seized_ctokens) at L776 with no branch to skip seizure for the ADLBorrow path — directly contradicting INV-003 (SG-010) which requires obligation.collateral_unchanged. An attacker can trigger this via the liquidate_adl_borrow entry point (requires PackageCallerCap) by invoking ADL borrow deleveraging on any obligation when system borrow limits are breached, causing the obligation holder to lose collateral proportional to the repay amount plus the liquidation incentive despite the spec guaranteeing collateral should be untouched. Severity retained at High: the violation harms user funds in a privileged-but-designed operation path, with no deployment_context.client_diversity cap applicable given the absence of that field in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: INV-003 (SG-010): ADLBorrow must reduce obligation debt without seizing proportional collateral from the obligation.
